answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the quartz of a task receipt, and the voyage is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
